# Rise and Battle the Day

## Scripture
"Be watchful, stand firm in the faith, act like men, be strong." – 1 Corinthians 16:13

## Reflection
Men, the alarm clock is not your enemy—your apathy is. Every morning you get a choice: roll over and let the day happen to you, or rise and take ground for the Kingdom. Paul's charge to the Corinthians wasn't a suggestion; it was a battle cry. "Act like men" means stepping into responsibility when it's easier to retreat. It means standing firm when culture tells you to compromise, when your flesh whispers to quit, when exhaustion begs you to coast.

But notice the order: be watchful first. A soldier who isn't alert gets ambushed. Are you watching your inputs—what you feed your eyes, your ears, your mind? Strength without vigilance is just recklessness. And this strength isn't your own. It flows from a God who never tires. Your job is to show up, stay alert, and stand. The battle is real, but so is the One who fights beside you. Don't drift through today. Take it.

## Daily Challenge
Do 25 pushups, and with each rep thank God for the strength to stand firm. Then text one brother and ask how you can pray for him today.
